INSERT INTO ingest_cursors (log_id, log_url, operator, last_tree_size, last_updated, state)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 0, now(), 'usable')
           ON CONFLICT (log_id) DO UPDATE
             SET log_url = excluded.log_url,
                 operator = excluded.operator,
                 last_updated = now()
